text: River Cities Community Calendar RogerAdkins Dec 4, 2025 20 mins ago 0 1 min to read Facebook Twitter WhatsApp SMS Email Facebook Twitter WhatsApp SMS Email Print Copy article link Save Ongoing: Alcoholics Anonymous meets every Wednesday at 7 p.m. at the Senior Resource Center, 1165 State Route 160, Gallipolis, Ohio. Details: 740-446-7000.Friday, Dec. 12, 2025O.O. McIntyre Park District Board meeting, 11 a.m., Park District Office, 18 Locust St., Gallipolis, Ohio. The purpose of the meeting is to conduct regular monthly board business. Questions regarding this meeting should be directed to the O.O. McIntyre Park District at 740-446-7000 or info@oomcintyreparkdistrict.org Wednesday, Dec. 17American Red Cross Blood Drive, 1:30-6 p.m., Mulberry Community Center Gym, 260 Mulberry Ave., Pomeroy, Ohio. Please bring photo ID or donor card. Or call 1-800-733-2767 or visit redcrossblood.org and enter Meigs Community to schedule an appointment. Donate between Dec. 8-18 and receive a $15 gift card by email. Visit website for details.District 18 – Ohio Public Works Commission Executive Committee meeting, 10 a.m., Buckeye Hills Regional Council office, 1400 Pike St., Marietta, Ohio. The purpose of the meeting is to review and approve the Fiscal Year 2027 (Round 40) State Capital Improvement Program and the Local Transportation Improvement Program slate of projects. Questions regarding this meeting should be directed to Jada Riley at 740-376-7636 or jriley@buckeyehills.org.
